ob_s1_title.message: You will never find that file again.

ob_s1_pt.message: Built for people who download all day. Researchers, accountants, anyone whose Downloads folder is quietly out of hand.

ob_s2_title.message: Watch a junk name turn into a real one.

ob_s2_lede.message: The default pattern is the date, then the site, then the original name. The moment a download finishes, the name is rewritten and written straight to disk. No click, no dialog. Here it is on a real file.

ob_s3_title.message: Set the naming pattern you keep for good.

ob_s3_lede.message: Build it from tokens. Click one to drop it into the pattern and watch the sample update. The real file extension is always kept on the end. Save it and every future download follows this.

ob_s3_pt.message: It lives in your browser. Change it any time from settings, and nothing about your files is ever sent anywhere.

ob_saved_msg.message: Saved. Every download follows this now.
ob_saved_msg.description: Confirmation after the pattern is saved.

ob_s4_kicker.message: Why you can leave it running

ob_s4_title.message: Local by design, built in the open by one developer.

ob_s4_lede.message: Your files and your rename history never leave this machine. On the free plan the extension makes no network call at all, and the code is small enough to read in one sitting.

ob_stat1_l.message: every rename runs on your device

ob_s4_pt.message: A download renamer is where you meet Zovo. The bigger plan is an honest layer for the whole extension world, one tool at a time, with no spam and no tracking.

ob_trust1_b.message: Your pattern, rules and history live in local browser storage. No account, no sync server, nothing sent out.

ob_trust2_h.message: One person, building in the open

ob_s5_title.message: Free renames forever. Or own it all, once.

ob_s5_lede.message: The silent rename core stays free, with no cap on how many files it touches. One payment of ninety-nine dollars turns on unlimited per-site rules, folder routing, regex clean-up, and naming from a page or PDF title.

ob_free1.message: Every download renamed on its own

ob_free2.message: The three core tokens: date, site, original name

ob_free4.message: Conflict handling and a live counter

ob_life2.message: Route files into Downloads subfolders by site or date

ob_life3.message: Regex clean-up plus page-title and PDF-title tokens

ob_life4.message: Config backup and import across machines

ob_life5.message: Every future update to this tool, included

ob_guarantee.message: 14-day refund, no questions. Prefer monthly? It is $$4.99 on the same page.

ob_s6_title.message: Nothing left to do. It is already working.

ob_s6_lede.message: The next file you download gets a clean name on its own. No button to press, no dialog to confirm. Here is what happens from here.

ob_dev_b.message: I build Zovo on my own, in the open. If something breaks, write to me and I answer. Renamers are just the start. The plan is an honest layer for the whole browser, and your ninety-nine dollars ships the next piece of it.
